verdict.rationale: Zep's agent-framework integrations page lists LiveKit as a supported framework. Separate performance docs claim sub-200ms context retrieval and a return_context option on add_messages that removes a round-trip, which supports live-conversation speed. However, LiveKit appears only as a name in a list, and no voice-specific latency or integration detail is shown. Missing for 10: Pipecat and ElevenLabs integrations, in-depth LiveKit/voice integration docs, voice-pipeline latency guidance or benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation

citations.quote: Use Zep as agent memory with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, Eve, and other supported frameworks.
The integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve data from the user's Context Graph.
Zep delivers sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs.

you can pass in the return_context=True flag to the thread.add_messages() method. Zep will perform a user graph search right after persisting the data and return the context relevant to the recently added messages.
